title: Tronian Omegatron 510 Vapor Cup (taxes extra)
description:
The Tronian Omegatron is a Vapor Cup designed to provide flavorful vapor with an uncomplicated system. Tronian made a strong entrance into the Vapor Cup market with this product. The Omegatron Vapor Cup differs from other Vapor Cups because it has an easy-to-use system that doesn’t require confusing touch buttons. Its heating chamber has a special Glass Core that evenly turns solid wax into vapor through tiny holes, giving you consistent and tasty vapor.

The Omegatron is also compatible with 510 threads, which makes it easy to maintain and seamlessly switch between your solid concentrates. You can even personalize the flavor by adding things like citrus peels or herbs to the cup. With these cool features, the Omegatron gives you an amazing vaporizing experience that is both simple to use and gives you high-quality vapor.

Key Features:
“Sippable” Vapor
Push Activated Auto-Filling
Innovative Glass Core Heating Element
Secondary Triple Helix Heating Element
510-Thread Compatible
3150 mAh

Included In The Box:
Tronian Omegatron
Glass Core
Triple Helix
Heating Element Cover
Wax Tool
USB-C Charging Cable

PULSAR SIPPER ALSO AVAILABLE

Please research the product before purchasing. Tronian products are not eligible for returns under any circumstances. Tronian sales are final.

If you have issues with your product, send an email to info@tronian.com and a customer service representative will contact you as early as possible to resolve the issue and find the best solution.
